ux.step_finish_body: You can restart this tour from Settings at any time.
ux.step_host_listing_body: Anyone can join a listed server that has no password. Unlisted servers stay out of the server browser, but anyone with the link or server id can still join them. Every player who joins, listed or not, receives your public IP address. You can change this in Settings.

ux.step_play_body: Pick a build and a server, then start the game.
ux.step_prerequisites_body: Some things the launcher needs are missing. Fix them now, or later from Settings.
ux.step_profile_body: Other players see this name in the lobby and in the killfeed. A new name applies from the next launch.
ux.step_welcome_body: Play and host old Fortnite builds with the community. This tour shows where everything is. You can skip any step or leave the tour at any time.
